scripts.check: npm run build && node --check src/index.js && node --check src/hosted-workspace.js && node --check src/mac-workers.js && node --test test/*.test.js
scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler dev --config wrangler.generated.jsonc
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.generated.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply trace-marketing-control --local --config wrangler.generated.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply trace-marketing-control --remote --config wrangler.generated.jsonc
